blocks.h2: Converting an Evanston Wood Fireplace to Gas
blocks.body: A gas log set gives you a fire with the flip of a switch and no ash to clean. In an older masonry fireplace, the conversion has three parts. A chimney professional confirms the flue is sound. We run a gas line to the firebox and install a shutoff valve. Then the log set is installed and tested. Vented logs need the damper held partly open, so we install a clamp to keep it from closing.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Fireplace Work
blocks.body: A yearly service is a short visit. A failed thermocouple, igniter or valve costs more because of the part. A wood-to-gas conversion depends on how far the gas line has to run and the log set you choose. We diagnose first and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Gas Fireplace Questions From Evanston Homeowners

items.q: Can my wood fireplace be converted to gas?
items.preview: Often, if the chimney is sound.
items.answer: Often. We run the gas line and install the valve. A chimney specialist handles the flue.

items.q: Why won't my pilot stay lit?
items.preview: A dirty pilot or weak thermocouple.
items.answer: Usually a dirty pilot or a weak thermocouple.

items.q: Do gas logs need the damper open?
items.answer: Yes, vented logs need the damper held partly open.

items.q: When should I service my fireplace?
items.answer: Early fall, before the first cold night.

items.q: Should I choose vented or unvented logs?
items.preview: Vented logs are the more common choice.
items.answer: Vented logs look more like a wood fire and send exhaust up the chimney. Unvented logs have stricter rules. We'll talk through the options.

items.q: Can you install a gas fireplace insert?
items.answer: We run the gas line and connect the insert. Venting and chimney work are done by a fireplace specialist.

items.q: How much does gas fireplace repair cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on the part. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what failed and the type of fireplace. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
